title: Figure 9. Per-participant average times to select the correct item in each block of nine trials.

metadata.alt_text: A series of box plots showing how the average time taken by participants to select the correct item changed as the blocks progressed. In the first 6 blocks, the median swoops downward from ~4000ms to ~1500ms, then stays around this level for the remaining blocks.
metadata.domain_context: From a paper published at CHI (2016). Figure caption: Figure 9. Per-participant average times to select the correct item in each block of nine trials.
